title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Revised Provisions on the Causes of Civil Cases
keywords_en: contract dispute; property rights; inheritance; arbitration; intellectual property; labor dispute; civil case
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Decision on Amending the Provisions on Causes of Action in Civil Cases

Fa [2025] No. 226

Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Decision of the Supreme People's Court on Amending the Provisions on Causes of Action in Civil Cases is hereby issued to you for earnest implementation.

December 16, 2025

Decision of the Supreme People's Court on Amending the Provisions on Causes of Action in Civil Cases

In accordance with the Civil Code of the PRC, the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, and other legal provisions, and in consideration of the actual work of civil trial by the people's courts, the following amendments are made to the Provisions on Causes of Action in Civil Cases, as amended for the second time on December 29, 2020:

I. Two first-level causes of action amended

1. A first-level cause of action "Part VI: Data and Internet Virtual Property Disputes" is added.

2. The first-level cause of action "Part VI: Labor and Personnel Disputes" is changed to "Part VII: Labor and Personnel Disputes and Employment Disputes in New Forms of Employment".

II. Six second-level causes of action amended

3. A second-level cause of action "XVII. Data Disputes" is added.

4. A second-level cause of action "XVIII. Internet Virtual Property Disputes" is added.

5. A second-level cause of action "XXI. Employment Disputes in New Forms of Employment" is added.

6. A second-level cause of action "XXVI. Disputes related to Farmers' Professional Cooperatives" is added.

7. A second-level cause of action "XLII. Cases of Confirmation of Ecological and Environmental Damage Compensation Agreements" is added.

8. The second-level cause of action "XLVIII. Cases of Arbitration Proceedings" is changed to "LIII. Cases of Judicial Review of Arbitration".

III. Ninety-eight third-level causes of action amended

9. Under the second-level cause of action "III. Inheritance Disputes": "34. Disputes over Distribution of Estate by Non-Statutory Heirs" is added.

10. Under the second-level cause of action "VI. Ownership Disputes": "46. Disputes over Infringement of the Rights and Interests of Collective Economic Organizations" and "57. Disputes over Compensation for Damage to Natural Resource Assets" are added.

11. Under the second-level cause of action "VII. Usufructuary Rights Disputes": "61. Disputes over Compensation for Overlap of Mineral Resources" is added.

12. Under the second-level cause of action "X. Contract Disputes": "94. Disputes over Contracts for Compensation for Overlap of Mineral Resources" is added; "140. Disputes over Contracts for Re-employment of Retired Personnel" is deleted.

13. Under the second-level cause of action "XIII. Intellectual Property Contract Disputes": "148. Patent Contract Disputes" is changed to "152. Invention Patent Contract Disputes", "153. Utility Model Patent Contract Disputes", and "154. Design Patent Contract Disputes".

14. Under the second-level cause of action "XIV. Intellectual Property Ownership and Infringement Disputes": third-level causes of action "166. Disputes over Infringement of Geographical Indications", "170. Disputes over Standard Essential Patents", "180. Disputes over Pharmaceutical Patent Linkage", "184. Disputes over Return of Fees After Invalidation of New Plant Variety Rights", and "185. Disputes over Return of Fees After Cancellation of Exclusive Rights in Layout Designs of Integrated Circuits" are added; "160. Patent Ownership and Infringement Disputes" is changed to "167. Invention Patent Ownership and Infringement Disputes", "168. Utility Model Patent Ownership and Infringement Disputes", and "169. Design Patent Ownership and Infringement Disputes".

15. Under the second-level cause of action "XV. Unfair Competition Disputes": "194. Disputes over Platform Operators' Forced Low-Price Sales" and "195. Disputes over Delinquent Accounts Owed to Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises by Abuse of Dominant Position" are added; "179. Disputes over Prize-Linked Sales" is changed to "190. Disputes over Unfair Prize-Linked Sales"; "177. Disputes over Dumping at Low Prices as Unfair Competition" and "178. Disputes over Tied Sales as Unfair Competition" are deleted.

16. Under the newly added second-level cause of action "XVII. Data Disputes": "199. Disputes over Data Ownership", "200. Disputes over Data Contracts", and "201. Disputes over Infringement of Data Rights and Interests" are added.

17. Under the newly added second-level cause of action "XVIII. Internet Virtual Property Disputes": "202. Disputes over Ownership of Internet Virtual Property" and "203. Disputes over Contracts for Internet Virtual Property" are added.

18. Under the second-level cause of action "XIX. Labor Disputes": "208. Disputes over Employment of Workers Exceeding Statutory Retirement Age" and "209. Disputes over Employer Liability of Contractors and Name-Lenders" are added.

19. Under the newly added second-level cause of action "XXI. Employment Disputes in New Forms of Employment": "214. Disputes over Employment Contracts in New Forms of Employment", "215. Disputes over Social Insurance in New Forms of Employment", and "216. Disputes over Occupational Injury Protection in New Forms of Employment" are added.

20. Under the second-level cause of action "XXII. Maritime and Admiralty Disputes": "226. Disputes over Liability for Defective Products for Ship Parts and Materials", "227. Disputes over Maritime Logistics Service Contracts", "233. Disputes over Ship Engineering Contracts", "234. Disputes over Ship Design Contracts", "236. Disputes over Seafarer Labor Contracts", "237. Disputes over Seafarer Labor Dispatch Contracts", "238. Disputes over Seafarer Service Contracts", "251. Disputes over Shipping Brokerage Contracts", "264. Disputes over Port and Wharf Lease Contracts", "272. Disputes over Ship Property Rights", and "273. Disputes over Ship Investment Operations" are added; "207. Disputes over Shipbuilding Contracts", "208. Disputes over Ship Repair Contracts", "209. Disputes over Ship Conversion Contracts", and "210. Disputes over Ship Dismantling Contracts" are changed to fourth-level causes of action under the newly added third-level cause of action "233. Disputes over Ship Engineering Contracts": "(1) Disputes over Shipbuilding Contracts", "(2) Disputes over Ship Repair Contracts", "(3) Disputes over Ship Conversion Contracts", and "(4) Disputes over Ship Dismantling Contracts"; "212. Disputes over Voyage Charter Contracts" is changed to a fourth-level cause of action under "240. Disputes over Ship Charter Contracts": "(3) Disputes over Voyage Charter Contracts"; "244. Disputes over Ship Co-ownership" and "245. Disputes over Ship Ownership" are deleted.

21. Under the second-level cause of action "XXIV. Disputes related to Companies": "294. Disputes over Forfeiture of Shareholder Rights", "300. Disputes over Removal of Directors, Supervisors, and Senior Officers", "308. Disputes over Validity of Resolutions of Bondholders' Meetings", and "309. Disputes over Bond Trustee's Damage to Bondholders' Interests" are added; "268. Disputes over Requesting Company to Repurchase Shares" is changed to "297. Disputes over Requesting Company to Repurchase Equity or Shares"; "273. Disputes over Promoters' Liability" is changed to "303. Disputes over Incorporators' Liability"; "284. Disputes over Liquidation Liability" is changed to "316. Disputes over Company Liquidation Liability".

22. Under the newly added second-level cause of action "XXVI. Disputes related to Farmers' Professional Cooperatives": "321. Disputes over Confirmation of Membership in Farmers' Professional Cooperatives", "322. Disputes over Capital Contributions by Members of Farmers' Professional Cooperatives", "323. Disputes over Merger of Farmers' Professional Cooperatives", "324. Disputes over Division of Farmers' Professional Cooperatives", "325. Disputes over Dissolution of Farmers' Professional Cooperatives", and "326. Disputes over Liquidation of Farmers' Professional Cooperatives" are added.

23. Under the second-level cause of action "XXXV. Tort Liability Disputes": "416. Disputes over Liability for Cross-Boundary Prospecting and Mining of Mineral Resources" and "417. Disputes over Liability for Tortious Overlap of Mineral Resources" are added; the order of "385. Disputes over Notarial Damage Liability" is adjusted to "430. Disputes over Notarial Damage Liability" (after "429. Disputes over Liability for Damage in Air Transport"); "369. Disputes over Internet Tort Liability" is deleted.

24. Under the newly added second-level cause of action "XLII. Cases of Confirmation of Ecological and Environmental Damage Compensation Agreements": "450. Application for Judicial Confirmation of Ecological and Environmental Damage Compensation Agreements" is added.

25. Under the second-level cause of action "XLIX. Cases of Application for Pre-Litigation Cessation of Infringement of Intellectual Property Rights": "473. Application for Pre-Litigation Cessation of Infringement of Technical Secrets" and "474. Application for Pre-Litigation Cessation of Infringement of Business Secrets" are added; "425. Application for Pre-Litigation Cessation of Patent Infringement" is changed to "465. Application for Pre-Litigation Cessation of Infringement of Invention Patents", "466. Application for Pre-Litigation Cessation of Infringement of Utility Model Patents", and "467. Application for Pre-Litigation Cessation of Infringement of Design Patents"; "430. Application for Pre-Litigation Cessation of Infringement of Exclusive Rights in Layout Designs of Integrated Circuits" is changed to "472. Application for Pre-Litigation Cessation of Infringement of Exclusive Rights in Layout Designs of Integrated Circuits".

26. Under the second-level cause of action "L. Cases of Application for Preservation": "434. Application for Pre-Arbitration Preservation of Property", "435. Application for Pre-Arbitration Preservation of Conduct", "436. Application for Pre-Arbitration Preservation of Evidence", "437. Preservation of Property in Arbitration Proceedings", and "438. Preservation of Evidence in Arbitration Proceedings" are changed to third-level causes of action under the newly changed second-level cause of action "LIII. Cases of Judicial Review of Arbitration": "485. Application for Pre-Arbitration Preservation of Property", "486. Application for Pre-Arbitration Preservation of Conduct", "487. Application for Pre-Arbitration Preservation of Evidence", "488. Preservation of Property in Arbitration Proceedings", and "490. Preservation of Evidence in Arbitration Proceedings".

27. Under the newly changed second-level cause of action "LIII. Cases of Judicial Review of Arbitration": "489. Preservation of Conduct in Arbitration Proceedings" is added.

28. Under the second-level cause of action "LV. Cases of Application for Recognition and Enforcement of Court Judgments and Arbitral Awards": "498. Application for Recognition and Enforcement of Court Judgments and Arbitral Awards from Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan Regions" and "499. Application for Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Court Judgments and Arbitral Awards" are added; "456. Application for Recognition and Enforcement of Civil Judgments of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Courts", "457. Application for Recognition and Enforcement of Arbitral Awards of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region", "458. Application for Recognition and Enforcement of Civil Judgments of the Macao Special Administrative Region Courts", "459. Application for Recognition and Enforcement of Arbitral Awards of the Macao Special Administrative Region", "460. Application for Recognition and Enforcement of Civil Judgments of the Taiwan Region Courts", and "461. Application for Recognition and Enforcement of Arbitral Awards of the Taiwan Region" are changed to fourth-level causes of action under the newly added third-level cause of action "498. Application for Recognition and Enforcement of Court Judgments and Arbitral Awards from Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan Regions": "(1) Application for Recognition and Enforcement of Civil Judgments of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Courts", "(2) Application for Recognition and Enforcement of Arbitral Awards of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region", "(3) Application for Recognition and Enforcement of Civil Judgments of the Macao Special Administrative Region Courts", "(4) Application for Recognition and Enforcement of Arbitral Awards of the Macao Special Administrative Region", "(5) Application for Recognition and Enforcement of Civil Judgments of the Taiwan Region Courts", and "(6) Application for Recognition and Enforcement of Arbitral Awards of the Taiwan Region"; "462. Application for Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Court Civil Judgments and Rulings" and "463. Application for Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards" are changed to fourth-level causes of action under the newly added third-level cause of action "499. Application for Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Court Judgments and Arbitral Awards": "(1) Application for Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Court Civil Judgments and Rulings" and "(2) Application for Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards"; "453. Application for Enforcement of Maritime Arbitral Awards", "454. Application for Enforcement of Intellectual Property Arbitral Awards", and "455. Application for Enforcement of Foreign-Related Arbitral Awards" are deleted.

29. Under the second-level cause of action "LVII. Public Interest Litigation": "503. Civil Public Interest Litigation for Protection of Cultural Relics and Cultural Heritage", "504. Civil Public Interest Litigation for Work Safety", "506. Civil Public Interest Litigation for Protection of Military Personnel Rights and Interests", "509. Civil Public Interest Litigation for Protection of Personal Information", and "510. Civil Public Interest Litigation for Protection of Women's Rights" are added.

IV. One hundred fourth-level causes of action amended

30. Under the third-level cause of action "35. Disputes over Inheritance Administration": "(1) Disputes over Inheritance Administrator's Liability" and "(2) Disputes over Inheritance Administrator's Remuneration" are added.

31. Under the third-level cause of action "72. Disputes over Pledge Rights": "(13) Disputes over Pledge of Rights related to Environmental Resources" is added.

32. Under the third-level cause of action "91. Disputes over Temporary Land Use Contracts": "(1) Disputes over Contracts for Temporary Land Use for Prospecting and Mining of Minerals" is added.

33. Under the third-level cause of action "118. Disputes over Factoring Contracts": "(1) Disputes over Factoring with Recourse", "(2) Disputes over Factoring without Recourse", and "(3) Disputes over Multiple Factoring" are added.

34. Under the third-level cause of action "120. Disputes over Construction Project Contracts": "(10) Disputes over Mine Construction Project Contracts", "(11) Disputes over Electricity, Water, Gas, and Heat Engineering Contracts", and "(12) Disputes over Ecological and Environmental Protection Engineering Contracts" are added.

35. Under the third-level cause of action "121. Disputes over Transport Contracts": "(17) Disputes over International Air Transport Contracts" and "(18) Disputes over International Road Transport Contracts" are added.

36. Under the third-level cause of action "142. Disputes over Service Contracts": "(23) Disputes over Elderly Care Service Contracts" and "(24) Disputes over Environmental Resource Service Contracts" are added.

37. Under the third-level cause of action "144. Disputes over Labor Service Contracts": "(1) Disputes over Labor Service Contracts with Workers Exceeding Statutory Retirement Age" is added.

38. Under the newly changed third-level causes of action "152. Invention Patent Contract Disputes", "153. Utility Model Patent Contract Disputes", and "154. Design Patent Contract Disputes": the fourth-level cause of action "(1) Disputes over Assignment of Patent Application Rights" under the original third-level cause of action "148. Patent Contract Disputes" is changed to fourth-level cause of action "(1) Disputes over Assignment of Invention Patent Application Rights" under "152. Invention Patent Contract Disputes", fourth-level cause of action "(1) Disputes over Assignment of Utility Model Patent Application Rights" under "153. Utility Model Patent Contract Disputes", and fourth-level cause of action "(1) Disputes over Assignment of Design Patent Application Rights" under "154. Design Patent Contract Disputes"; the fourth-level cause of action "(2) Disputes over Assignment of Patent Rights" under the original third-level cause of action "148. Patent Contract Disputes" is changed to fourth-level cause of action "(2) Disputes over Assignment of Invention Patent Rights" under "152. Invention Patent Contract Disputes", fourth-level cause of action "(2) Disputes over Assignment of Utility Model Patent Rights" under "153. Utility Model Patent Contract Disputes", and fourth-level cause of action "(2) Disputes over Assignment of Design Patent Rights" under "154. Invention Patent Contract Disputes", fourth-level cause of action "(4) Disputes over Utility Model Patent Agency Contracts" under "153. Utility Model Patent Contract Disputes", and fourth-level cause of action "(4) Disputes over Design Patent Agency Contracts" under "154. Design Patent Contract Disputes"; under "152. Invention Patent Contract Disputes", the fourth-level cause of action "(5) Disputes over Invention Patent Open License" is added; under "153. Utility Model Patent Contract Disputes", the fourth-level cause of action "(5) Disputes over Utility Model Patent Open License" is added; under "154. Design Patent Contract Disputes", the fourth-level cause of action "(5) Disputes over Design Patent Open License" is added.

39. Under the newly changed third-level causes of action "167. Disputes over ownership and infringement of invention patent rights," "168. Disputes over ownership and infringement of utility model patent rights," and "169. Disputes over ownership and infringement of design patent rights": Change the fourth-level cause of action "(1) Disputes over ownership of patent application rights" under the original third-level cause of action "160. Disputes over ownership and infringement of patent rights" to "(1) Disputes over ownership of invention patent application rights" under "167. Disputes over ownership and infringement of invention patent rights," to "(1) Disputes over ownership of utility model patent application rights" under "168. Disputes over ownership and infringement of utility model patent rights," and to "(1) Disputes over ownership of design patent application rights" under "169. Disputes over ownership and infringement of design patent rights"; change the fourth-level cause of action "(2) Disputes over ownership of patent rights" under the original third-level cause of action "160. Disputes over ownership and infringement of patent rights" to "(2) Disputes over ownership of invention patent rights" under "167. Disputes over ownership and infringement of invention patent rights," to "(2) Disputes over ownership of utility model patent rights" under "168. Disputes over ownership and infringement of utility model patent rights," and to "(2) Disputes over ownership of design patent rights" under "169. Disputes over ownership and infringement of patent rights" to "(4) Disputes over passing off invention patents" under "167. Disputes over ownership and infringement of invention patent rights," to "(4) Disputes over passing off utility model patents" under "168. Disputes over ownership and infringement of utility model patent rights," and to "(4) Disputes over passing off design patents" under "169. Disputes over ownership and infringement of design patent rights"; change the fourth-level cause of action "(8) Disputes over rewards and remuneration for service invention creators and designers" under the original third-level cause of action "160. Disputes over ownership and infringement of patent rights" to "(6) Disputes over rewards and remuneration for service invention creators of inventions" under "167. Disputes over ownership and infringement of invention patent rights," to "(5) Disputes over rewards and remuneration for service invention creators of utility models" under "168. Disputes over ownership and infringement of utility model patent rights," and to "(5) Disputes over rewards and remuneration for service designers of designs" under "169. Disputes over ownership and infringement of design patent rights"; change the fourth-level cause of action "(9) Disputes over the right of attribution of invention creators and designers" under the original third-level cause of action "160. Disputes over ownership and infringement of patent rights" to "(7) Disputes over the right of attribution of inventors of invention patents" under "167. Disputes over ownership and infringement of invention patent rights," to "(6) Disputes over the right of attribution of inventors of utility model patents" under "168. Disputes over ownership and infringement of utility model patent rights," and to "(6) Disputes over the right of attribution of designers of design patents" under "169. Disputes over ownership and infringement of design patent rights"; change the fourth-level cause of action "(4) Disputes over infringement of utility model patent rights" under the original third-level cause of action "160. Disputes over ownership and infringement of patent rights" to "(3) Disputes over infringement of utility model patent rights" under "168. Disputes over ownership and infringement of utility model patent rights"; change the fourth-level cause of action "(5) Disputes over infringement of design patent rights" under the original third-level cause of action "160. Disputes over ownership and infringement of patent rights" to "(3) Disputes over infringement of design patent rights" under "169. Disputes over ownership and infringement of design patent rights."

Disputes over standard essential patents": Add "(1) Disputes over infringement of standard essential patent rights"; change the fourth-level cause of action "(10) Disputes over royalty for use of standard essential patents" under the original third-level cause of action "160. Disputes over ownership and infringement of patent rights" to "(2) Disputes over licensing of standard essential patents" under the newly added "170. Disputes over standard essential patents."

41. Under the third-level cause of action "171. Disputes over ownership and infringement of new plant variety rights": Add "(4) Disputes over passing off new plant varieties," "(6) Disputes over the right of attribution of new plant variety breeders," and "(7) Disputes over confirmation of essentially derived varieties."

42. Under the third-level cause of action "172. Disputes over ownership and infringement of exclusive rights in integrated circuit layout designs": Add "(3) Disputes over the right of attribution of creators of integrated circuit layout designs."

43. Under the third-level cause of action "179. Disputes over confirmation of non-infringement of intellectual property rights": Add "(9) Disputes over confirmation of non-infringement of technical secrets," "(10) Disputes over confirmation of non-infringement of business secrets"; change "(1) Disputes over confirmation of non-infringement of patent rights" to "(1) Disputes over confirmation of non-infringement of invention patent rights," "(2) Disputes over confirmation of non-infringement of utility model patent rights," "(3) Disputes over confirmation of non-infringement of design patent rights"; change "(5) Disputes over confirmation of non-infringement of exclusive rights in integrated circuit layout designs" to "(7) Disputes over confirmation of non-infringement of exclusive rights in integrated circuit layout designs."

44. Under the third-level cause of action "181. Disputes over liability for damages arising from application for interim measures in intellectual property matters": Add "(4) Disputes over liability for damages arising from application for interim measures to cease infringement of utility model patent rights," "(5) Disputes over liability for damages arising from application for interim measures to cease infringement of design patent rights," "(10) Disputes over liability for damages arising from application for interim measures to cease infringement of technical secrets," "(11) Disputes over liability for damages arising from application for interim measures to cease infringement of business secrets"; change "(1) Disputes over liability for damages arising from application for pre-litigation interim measures to cease infringement of patent rights," "(2) Disputes over liability for damages arising from application for pre-litigation interim measures to cease infringement of registered trademark rights," "(3) Disputes over liability for damages arising from application for pre-litigation interim measures to cease infringement of copyrights," "(4) Disputes over liability for damages arising from application for pre-litigation interim measures to cease infringement of new plant variety rights," "(5) Disputes over liability for damages arising from application for customs protection measures of intellectual property rights," "(6) Disputes over liability for damages arising from application for pre-litigation interim measures to cease infringement of computer software copyrights," "(7) Disputes over liability for damages arising from application for pre-litigation interim measures to cease infringement of exclusive rights in integrated circuit layout designs" to "(3) Disputes over liability for damages arising from application for interim measures to cease infringement of invention patent rights," "(2) Disputes over liability for damages arising from application for interim measures to cease infringement of registered trademark rights," "(1) Disputes over liability for damages arising from application for interim measures to cease infringement of copyrights," "(6) Disputes over liability for damages arising from application for interim measures to cease infringement of new plant variety rights," "(9) Disputes over liability for damages arising from application for customs protection measures of intellectual property rights," "(7) Disputes over liability for damages arising from application for interim measures to cease infringement of computer software copyrights," "(8) Disputes over liability for damages arising from application for interim measures to cease infringement of exclusive rights in integrated circuit layout designs."

45. Under the third-level cause of action "183. Disputes over refund of fees after declaration of patent invalidity": Add "(1) Disputes over refund of fees after declaration of invention patent invalidity," "(2) Disputes over refund of fees after declaration of utility model patent invalidity," "(3) Disputes over refund of fees after declaration of design patent invalidity."

46. Under the third-level cause of action "186. Disputes over passing off": Change "(2) Disputes over unauthorized use of another person's enterprise name, social organization name, or name that has a certain influence" to "(2) Disputes over unauthorized use of another person's name or appellation that has a certain influence"; change "(3) Disputes over unauthorized use of another person's domain name main part, website name, or webpage that has a certain influence" to "(3) Disputes over unauthorized use of another person's online activity identifier that has a certain influence."

47. Under the third-level cause of action "193. Disputes over network unfair competition": Add "(1) Disputes over obstructing or destroying legitimate online products or services," "(2) Disputes over improperly obtaining or using data," "(3) Disputes over abusing platform rules for malicious transactions."

48. Under the third-level cause of action "196. Disputes over monopoly agreements": Add "(3) Disputes over organizing or assisting in the reaching of monopoly agreements."

49. Under the third-level cause of action "197. Disputes over abuse of market dominance": Add "(7) Disputes over other abuses of market dominance"; change "(1) Disputes over monopoly pricing" to "(1) Disputes over unfair pricing"; change "(2) Disputes over predatory pricing" to "(2) Disputes over selling below cost"; change "(5) Disputes over tying transactions" to "(5) Disputes over tying, bundling, or imposing other unreasonable trading conditions."

50. Under the newly added third-level cause of action "214. Disputes over employment contracts in new forms of employment": Add "(1) Disputes over confirmation of labor relations in new forms of employment," "(2) Disputes over recovery of labor remuneration in new forms of employment."

51. Under the newly added third-level cause of action "215. Disputes over social insurance in new forms of employment": Add "(1) Disputes over work-related injury insurance benefits in new forms of employment."

52. Under the newly added third-level cause of action "272. Disputes over real rights in ships": Add "(1) Disputes over ship ownership," "(2) Disputes over ship mortgages," "(3) Disputes over maritime liens," "(4) Disputes over ship possessory liens."

53. Under the third-level cause of action "292. Disputes over requests for change of company registration": Add "(1) Disputes over removal of company registration (recordation)."

54. Under the third-level cause of action "293. Disputes over shareholder capital contributions": Add "(1) Disputes over shareholder's failure to fully perform capital contribution obligations," "(2) Disputes over shareholder's withdrawal of capital contributions," "(3) Disputes over accelerated maturity of shareholder capital contributions."

55. Under the third-level cause of action "299. Disputes over company resolutions": Add "(3) Disputes over confirmation of non-existence of company resolutions."

56. Under the third-level cause of action "307. 57. Under the newly changed third-level cause of action "316. Disputes over liability for company liquidation": Add "(1) Disputes over liability of liquidation obligors," "(2) Disputes over liability of members of the liquidation group."

58. Under the third-level cause of action "333. Disputes over confirmation of bankruptcy claims": Add "(1) Disputes over confirmation of priority bankruptcy claims."

59. Under the deleted third-level cause of action "369. Disputes over network tort liability": Change "(1) Disputes over infringement of virtual property through the network" to the newly added second-level cause of action "XVIII. Disputes over network virtual property" under the third-level cause of action "204. Disputes over infringement of rights to network virtual property."

60. Under the third-level cause of action "411. Disputes over liability for motor vehicle traffic accidents": Add "(1) Disputes over liability for traffic accidents involving intelligent connected vehicles."

61. Under the third-level cause of action "413. Disputes over liability for medical damage": Change "(1) Disputes over liability for infringement of patient's right to informed consent" to "(1) Disputes over liability for medical diagnosis and treatment."

This Decision shall come into force on January 1, 2026.

The Provisions on Causes of Civil Cases shall be republished after being amended in accordance with this Decision and the order of its articles being adjusted.
